newsitem.title: USA: Microage reorganizes, names O'Malley Pres.
newsitem.headline: Microage reorganizes, names O'Malley Pres.

text.p: MicroAge Inc on Monday said it reorganized its operations into four groups and promoted two executives, including Robert O'Malley to president.
The company's four principal business groups are now the MicroAge Distribution Group, the MicroAge Integration Group, the MicroAge Logistics Group and the MicroAge Services Group.

Distribution provides over 20,000 hardware and software products to resellers. Integration offers computing products to large companies and government agencies. Logistics operates the company's shipping programs, and the services group surveys customers and sets strategies for their needs.

"We believe this corporate structure will enable us to facilitate the ongoing growth of our services business as we continue to build on our winning model as a global systems integrator and full-line distributor," Chief Executive Officer Jeffrey McKeever said in a statement.
In addition, MicroAge named O'Malley as its president with the chief duties of overseeing the logistics group and services group.
It also installed James Manton as senior vice president operations at the parent, where he is responsible for process improvement, streamlining and cost cutting.
